sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: MACM courses are counted in an alternating fashion towards the MATH and CMPT requirements, starting with the first MACM course completed counting towards either MATH or CMPT. 18 units must be completed at the 400 division or higher, including at least six units each of CMPT and MATH.

sections.note:
Students complete 51 units, including all of.
and additional course work to total 27 upper division MATH units and 24 upper division CMPT units including core requirements.

sections.title: Other Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Of the total 120 units required for honours, at least 60 must be from the upper division.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must also achieve a 3.00 or better CGPA and UDGPA in each of the CMPT, MACM and MATH designations.

sections.note:
The program is subject to Faculty of Science and University regulations.
Course and prerequisite admission is subject to departmental requirements.
MACM major graduation is contingent upon a cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division grade point average (UDGPA) of 3.00 or better.
Admission, continuation and graduation in the MACM honours is contingent upon 3.00 or better on all relevant GPAs.
Faculty of Applied Sciences residency requirements appy to the computing science courses used toward the program.

sections.title: Other requirements
sections.note: Please see Faculty of Applied Sciences Residency Requirements for further information.
